description: Change a variant's name, words or weight, or pause it (`paused: true`) or resume it (`paused: false`): send only what changes. A paused variant is not drawn; if every variant is paused the original sends. A lead that already drew a variant keeps it while it can send, and draws again when it is paused. Any change except a pause alone adds to what the campaign sends, a weight change included: it moves leads onto arms nobody approved at that share. A resume needs a message in the body. Subject and bodies are Liquid templates (`{{ first_name }}`, `{{ contact["Company size"] }}`, `{% if company %}`) with spintax (`{Hi|Hello}`) after them. One that does not parse answers 400 `templateInvalid`, with `details` naming each part and its line and column. Nothing is saved. Words in double brackets ([[like this]]) are a template's blanks: a save that still holds one answers 400 `stepBlank`, naming it. To start from words that already exist (list_campaign_templates, or get_saved_reply), copy them in as `bodyText`, and send `bodyHtml: ""` too when the step already has a formatted part, since most mail apps show that part. On a running campaign, a change that adds to what it sends or to whom also needs the `send` permission, and makes the caller its approver. Through an API key an owner limited, the key's limits must cover the campaign, every mailbox it sends from and outreach, or it answers 403 with `details.scope` naming the limit. A change that only takes something out needs none of that.

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.
